effect:
A Ball that makes Pokémon friendly.

Friend Ball sets a caught Pokémon's base friendship to 200, significantly higher than the normal 70! This means less grinding for friendship evolutions like Espeon, Umbreon, or baby Pokémon!

Made from Green Apricorns by Kurt. If you're hunting for Pokémon that evolve through friendship, this ball cuts your evolution time by a ton.
